angles.headline: The eight-figure art gallery with no gallery
angles.pitch: How Avery launched ArtLife.com in 2015 as one of the first online-only blue-chip galleries and scaled it into an eight-figure-a-year business, and the 'Click & Mortar' playbook (social-first marketing plus curated pop-ups) that others copied.
angles.builds_on: The show's 'business you've never heard of' deep dives (Ep. #293, #340).

angles.headline: The art dealer as connector
angles.pitch: Avery is the middleman between artists and high-net-worth buyers, from placing a $100K+ Hap Tivey work with Kris Jenner at Art Basel Miami Beach 2024 to advising athletes; he breaks down how that connector business actually makes money.

angles.headline: Turning one artist into a global brand
angles.pitch: How Avery developed street artist Alec Monopoly into a global brand with sold-out shows from New York to Morocco and major brand partnerships, told as a repeatable business-building case study.
angles.builds_on: The show's deep-dive and growth-hacking format; the live judging episode (Ep. #339) shows appetite for concrete revenue stories.
